name: mgba-3a5bc246-blind28
instr:
# mGBA: diagnosing and repairing injected misbehaviour without a test suite

The repository has received 28 separate undocumented edits.

This program emulates handheld game machines and carries the tooling that goes with one: it opens files, writes them back, lets you poke at a running game, and lets you drive the whole thing from a small automation program. In a number of unrelated places it now produces the wrong answer, and in several it stops outright where it used to carry on. Nothing about the hardware being emulated changed, and nothing about the files handed to it changed.

Start with what it makes of the files it is given. A losslessly compressed picture with more than one row of pixels loads as a picture in which every row carries the same pixel data instead of the rows the file stored. A saved table read back from a file whose contents are not in the save format crashes the process instead of reporting that nothing could be loaded. Handing the cartridge loader nothing at all crashes rather than reporting that the load failed. Parsing a quoted run of text whose contents include an escaped quote mark fails to produce that quote mark in the result. Converting text with characters outside the basic range from one supported encoding to another changes the character, so what comes out is not the code point that went in.
